text: 11月2日至3日，中亚经济合作天山论坛在哈萨克斯坦阿拉木图举行，财政部部长蓝佛安出席开幕式并致辞，部长助理常军红陪同参会。蓝佛安指出，今年是中国“十五五”规划开局之年，中国经济运行总体平稳、稳中有进，前三季度国内生产总值同比增长4.6%，展现出强大韧性和活力。中国将持续推动高质量发展，扩大高水平开放，为包括中亚国家在内的世界各国带来更多发展机遇。同时，中方愿与中亚各国加强合作，大力弘扬“中国—中亚精神”，构建更加紧密的中国—中亚命运共同体，支持中亚地区发展成为连通欧亚大陆的“黄金十字路口”。（财政部）
text_en: From November 2 to 3, the Tianshan Forum on Central Asian Economic Cooperation was held in Almaty, Kazakhstan. Minister of Finance Lan Fo'an attended the opening ceremony and delivered remarks, accompanied by Assistant Minister Chang Junhong. Lan Fo'an noted that this year is the first year of China's 15th Five-Year Plan, and China's economy has been generally stable with steady progress, with GDP growing 4.6% year on year in the first three quarters, demonstrating strong resilience and vitality. China will continue to promote high-quality development and expand high-level opening up, bringing more development opportunities to countries around the world, including Central Asian countries. At the same time, China is willing to strengthen cooperation with Central Asian countries, vigorously promote the "China-Central Asia Spirit," build an even closer China-Central Asia community with a shared future, and support the Central Asian region in developing into a "golden crossroads" connecting the Eurasian continent. (Ministry of Finance)
